cards.text: The LORD has a message for His people, and He speaks it through Jeremiah, His prophet. He tells them to stand at the crossroads and look, and to ask for the ancient paths: where is the good way? Then walk in it.

cards.question: The LORD promises that if they walk in the good way, they will find ___ for their souls.
True or false: The people agree to walk in the good way the LORD points them to.

cards.text: Their answer: “We will not walk in it!” The LORD also says He appointed watchmen over them and told them, “Listen for the sound of the ram’s horn.”

cards.question: The ram’s horn is the warning signal. When the people are told to listen for it, what do they answer?

cards.text: Twice they say no, so the LORD calls on the nations, the congregations and the whole earth to hear what will happen to this people. Friend, this just left the private chat and went out to EVERYBODY.

cards.question: The LORD says He is bringing disaster on this people. What reason does He give?

answers.text: They bowed down to other gods

cards.question: The LORD calls the disaster coming on this people the fruit of their own ___.

cards.text: Their gifts are fancy: frankincense from Sheba and sweet cane from a distant land, plus burnt offerings and sacrifices. Friend, that’s ordering something from the other side of the world and paying more for SHIPPING than for the thing itself.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says their burnt offerings are acceptable to Him.

cards.text: Therefore the LORD says He will lay stumbling blocks before this people. You know that dark living room at night, where your FEET find every single thing you left on the floor?

cards.question: Fathers and sons alike will be staggered by these stumbling blocks. What does the LORD say will happen to friends and neighbors?

cards.text: Then the LORD says to look: an army is coming from the land of the north. It's a great nation, stirred up from the ends of the earth.

cards.question: This army from the north grasps the bow and spear. How does the LORD describe them?

cards.text: Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against the Daughter of Zion. Friend, ONE horse looks at me funny and I'm diving face-first into the chocolate chips.

cards.question: True or false: When the people hear the report about this army, they get ready to fight.

cards.text: Then the prophet speaks as one of the people: “We have heard the report; our hands hang limp.” Anguish has them in its grip, pain like that of a woman in labor.

cards.question: The enemy has a sword, and terror is on every side. True or false: The people are told to go out to the fields and walk the road.
Then the prophet calls on the daughter of his people to dress in sackcloth, roll in ashes and mourn as they would for an only son. Why mourn like that?

cards.text: Then the LORD hands out a job: “I have appointed you to examine My people like ore, so you may know and try their ways.” That's me breaking one cookie open to see what a batch is REALLY like inside.

cards.question: After the examining, the LORD says His people are all hardened ___, walking around as slanderers.

cards.text: They are bronze and iron, and all of them are corrupt. Then the picture turns to a furnace: the bellows blow fiercely, blasting away the lead with fire.

cards.question: True or false: The refining fire purges the wicked out of the people.

cards.text: The refining proceeds in vain. That's me pulling a batch out after an hour at full heat, and it's STILL dough in the middle.

cards.question: In the end, the LORD's people are called rejected silver. Why that name?

answers.text: Because the LORD has rejected them
Because the nations have rejected them
Because the fire has melted them
